broker_name: First Choice Business Brokers - San Francisco Bay

fields.note: This site uses DudaMobile website builder with dm-bfs (business-for-sale) module. Content is dynamically loaded via JavaScript and cannot be scraped with static HTML parsing.

notes: FCBB San Francisco Bay uses a DudaMobile website builder with JavaScript-rendered listings. The page shows 'dm-bfs' class indicating a business-for-sale module, but all listing content is loaded client-side. This requires either: 1) Playwright/Selenium with JavaScript execution, 2) Finding an API endpoint that the JavaScript calls, or 3) A specialized FCBB scraper that handles their specific platform. The URL pattern is /businesses-for-sale with query parameters for filtering (location, sort, page). Standard static HTML scraping returns only the page shell with no listing data.
